sentences.en: I negotiated with the travel agent about the ticket price.
sentences.zh: 我和旅行社就票务价格进行了洽谈。

sentences.en: The two countries will negotiate a settlement to the crisis.
sentences.zh: 两国将就危机问题进行协商以达成解决方案。

sentences.en: He negotiated a lower price with the real estate agent.
sentences.zh: 他和房地产中介协商后得到了更低的价格。

phrases.zh: 与恐怖分子谈判（通常指不正当的谈判）
